name: Lavender
source:
"Making our guests' day with a bit of beauty is what I live for. And seeing these plants thrive? That's just the cherry on top."

Lavender oversees all the cleaning and laundry in the mansion and tends to the courtyard. Her heavy workload often requires other maids to pitch in. Her maid uniform sets her apart; it's a unique design ingeniously repurposed from her kimono.

Though reserved and soft-spoken, Lavender harbors an insatiable curiosity, particularly regarding Akira, a newcomer from beyond the mansion's walls. She cares deeply for the courtyard plants, treating them like her own children.

[u][b]Akira's Memo[/b][/u]
Lavender handles all the cleaning and laundry in the mansion, including the undies, which was a bit awkward for me. I tried to do my own laundry, but she wouldn't hear of it—"strictly business," she says. It's still embarrassing that other maids might get their hands on them, though. Lavender usually keeps a poker face, but every now and then she lets her guard down, revealing a sweet smile, especially when she's humming away in the courtyard.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/femme_fatale/chara03.html]official website[/url]]
